title: Blaizio registry
description: A registry manifest (registry.json), and the index.json catalogue built from it.

name.description: The registry's display name, carried into index.json and shown by search.

items.description: Every installable unit. Names must be unique across the registry.

include.description: Other manifests folded into this one, as file paths relative to the manifest that lists them. Folded away by 'blaizio build', so a served index.json never carries one.

styles.description: Written by 'blaizio build' into index.json when the registry ships per-skin variants: each listed skin has a full copy of every item under <base>/<skin>/. Absent from a manifest.

pagination.description: Written by a DYNAMIC registry answering a search server-side: items is the requested page of an already-filtered set, and the client must not filter it again. Never in a manifest, and never written by a static registry.

total.description: How many items matched in total, across every page.

offset.description: How many matched items precede this page.

limit.description: The page size the server applied.

hasMore.description: True when more matches exist past this page.
